scope: Future debug dispatch discovery only; no remote commands or concurrency settings changed.
reported_case: Two parallel agents dispatch the same workflow and revision. A stale newest-run list selects another client’s worker and SSH rejects its key.
analogous_case: Concurrent Windows debug runs use different client keys but the same source revision; each caller must identify its own dispatch.
dissimilar_case: A caller already has an authoritative run ID. It can use that ID without requiring a display identifier.
invariant: Correlate each client with its own dispatch before obtaining connection details; source revision or newest position alone is insufficient.
mechanism: Optional caller-generated session_id appears in run-name together with target. Empty input preserves the current display name. Caller chooses a fresh unique value and matches its exact display name, rather than newest run.
remote_execution_gate: Unrun: this change affects workflow metadata only. Existing active and queued runs retain their own original definitions.
